milestones.outcome: A controller manages approved fleet tap bindings and can use them to resolve and roll out skills.
exit_criteria: Public tap list, add, untap, approval and partial signed receipt handling work across selected disposable peers.
Bounded delegation preserves static authority, enrollment, local ownership and transport and supports non-forwarded install and upgrade.
Canonical fleet management guidance is portable, capability-gated and checked against the fixture runtime.
milestones.boundary: Use disposable fixtures. Real enrollment, credentials, deployment and publication are outside this milestone.
